setupDescription: Connect to your Mihomo backend to get started
controlCenterDesc: Manage the bundled kernel and host integration
desktopSilentUpdateCheckDesc: Notify when a new release is available (never installs anything)
desktopTunAutoRestoreDesc: Re-enable TUN on startup when the last session used it and the helper is installed
desktopShowTraySpeedDesc: Live upload/download rate in the menu bar / tray tooltip

desktopHotkeyRecordHint: Press a key combination with a modifier. Backspace clears, Esc cancels.
name: Name

restartCoreConfirm: Restart the core? This will interrupt all active connections.
upgradeUIConfirm: Upgrade the dashboard? This downloads and replaces the current web dashboard files.

orderLatency_asc: By latency from low to high
orderLatency_desc: By latency from high to low
orderQuality_asc: By quality from low to high
orderQuality_desc: By quality from high to low

secretHint: Leave empty if your backend has no secret
connectPrompt: Connect to your Mihomo backend to get started.
tagClientSourceIPWithName: Tag Client Source IP With Name
resolveClientHostnameDesc: Show device names for LAN clients and names for raw-IP destinations via reverse DNS. Requires mihomo's DNS to resolve the relevant reverse zones.

tunNeedsProfile: Import a subscription before enabling TUN mode.
tunUninstallFailed: Failed to uninstall the helper service
tunUninstallConfirm: Uninstall the privileged helper service? You'll be prompted to elevate again the next time you enable TUN.
sortOverriddenBySearch: Sorted by search relevance while searching
dataUsageInfo: Data usage monitoring is performed on the client-side (browser). When the browser is closed, monitoring will likely not run.

recommendation.title: Smart Recommendation
recommendation.autoSwitchDesc: Automatically switch to the recommended node after testing

kernelRollbackConfirm: Restore the last-known-good config and restart the kernel?

tunnelsHint: Forward a local listener to a remote target through the kernel.

process.triggerSnapshot: Traffic observation at trigger: active {active} / {activeLimit} seconds, download {traffic} / {trafficLimit} MiB, throughput {rate} Mbps, suspicion threshold {rateLimit} Mbps.
process.coverageHelp: This is the selected pool, not a claim that every node was checked. Obtained samples may have expired; the comparison details show the evidence actually used.
process.coverageCounts: Lightweight checks: {probes} · valid samples obtained: {samples} · complete comparisons: {comparisons}
process.actualTiming: Actual warmup {warmup} seconds; actual effective sample {sample} seconds. A dash means no corresponding measurement was obtained.
process.protection: Recent switches: {count} / {limit}; hold until {hold}; switch-count limit earliest release: {until}.
process.title: Decision process · {group}
process.readDelayed: Update delayed; keeping previous records and retrying automatically
process.disabled: Bandwidth assistance is disabled; retained rounds remain available
process.suspended: Automatic selection is paused or waiting for runtime readiness
process.engineError: The scheduler reported an error; inspect completion time and error code
process.stalled: No new scheduler completion has been recorded for one minute
process.archiveError: The process archive is unavailable or a write failed. Records may be incomplete; selection continues under its existing rules.
process.triggerConditions: Why a check starts or has not started
process.conditionsHelp: These are the sustained low-traffic-speed trigger conditions. Manual checks, latency degradation and preferred recovery can also start a check. Values use saved settings; idle traffic is not evidence of poor throughput.
process.noObservation: No fresh traffic observation is available. Missing data does not mean zero throughput or node failure.
process.sharedBudget: Instance-wide budget including degradation reserves; this is not an exclusive allowance for this group.
process.retry: Earliest retry: {time}; resources and evidence must still qualify.
process.retention: Up to 100 rounds per scheme/group for 7 days, with an 8 MiB archive ceiling. Recording since: {time}.
process.evicted: Older records have been removed by age, count or capacity limits.
process.empty: No check rounds are retained. Inspect trigger conditions or check this group’s candidates. Opening this page does not trigger a check; earlier activity cannot be reconstructed.
process.roundStats: Pool: {count} nodes · retained sample usage: {bytes} MiB
process.snapshotHelp: Saved parameters for this round: target {target} Mbps, {rounds} valid samples required. History is not recalculated with current settings.
process.truncated: Some intermediate events were truncated because this round grew large. The displayed process is incomplete.
process.noComparison: No complete comparison yet. Inspect the timeline for screening, missing samples or resource waits.
process.gain: Conservative gain {gain} must strictly exceed threshold {threshold}.
process.gap: Approximately {value} short of the threshold; equality also keeps the current node.
process.executionHelp: Passing comparison still requires execution checks. Consult the timeline for hold periods, latency rechecks, observation mode and switch outcomes.
process.gainFormula: Conservative gain = current lower bound {current} − candidate upper bound {candidate} − unfamiliarity risk {risk} = {gain}.
process.thresholdFormula: Threshold = max(absolute gain {absolute}, relative gain {relative}) + cost {cost} = {threshold}.
process.costParts: Costs: base {base}, recent switches {recent}, reverse switch {reverse}, preferred-to-fallback preference {preference}.
process.guardValues: Required: candidate delay ≤ {delay} ms; conservative throughput ≥ {rate} Mbps.
process.rank: Candidate ranking loss: {value}; lower is better, including unfamiliarity and fallback preference costs.
process.scoreHelp: Lower loss is better. Scores are engineering comparisons; intervals include measurement and aging margins, not statistical confidence or actual outage duration.
process.samples: Effective samples used in this comparison
process.delayCorrection: Original delay {raw} ms → comparison delay {effective} ms (fresh lightweight checks only reduce expected gain).
process.sampleLoss: Latency contribution {delay} + throughput shortfall {shortfall} = sample loss {total}.
process.margin: Sample safety and aging margin at comparison: ±{value}.
process.probe: Proxy delay to automatic probe target: {delay} ms · {result}
process.screening: Best conservative gain at target throughput {gain}, threshold {threshold}; delay {delay} ms versus allowed {limit} ms. Download verification skipped.
process.sampleResult: {result} sample · {rate} Mbps · {bytes} MiB used · expand details
process.sampleTiming: Task started {start}, elapsed {elapsed} seconds; configured warmup {warmup} seconds, minimum effective sample {minimum} seconds.
process.probeSource: Decisions use proxy latency to the automatic probe target ({delay} ms), not TCP latency or download-service response time.
process.verificationHelp: Throughput is a controlled download verification to a fixed service. Peaks above target receive no extra reward; invalid samples are not recorded as zero throughput.
process.missing: This round expired, was evicted, or is temporarily unavailable.

reason.runtime-pending: Configuration and runtime differ; round interrupted
reason.snapshot-locked: Operation lock held while reading runtime; round interrupted
reason.probe-target-changed: Automatic probe target changed; previous evidence invalidated
reason.selection-changed: Another selection flow changed the exit; round ended
reason.gain-confirmed: Gain comparison passed; checking execution conditions
reason.probe-retry: Probe service requested a retry delay
reason.faster-candidate: Another performance selection flow changed the exit

coco.bandwidthDescription: Bandwidth-assisted selection combines latency and download throughput to assess whether switching to a candidate is worthwhile.
coco.budgetDescription: Limit automatic download verification traffic. The degradation reserve is included in the total budget.
coco.gainDescription: Assess whether a candidate improves enough to justify switching. Reference values are not hard exclusion limits.
coco.protectionDescription: Reduce repeated switching with hold durations, switch limits, and switching costs.
coco.samplingDescription: Configure each download verification and the confirmation requirements for samples from the same node.
coco.evidenceDescription: Limit the use of old evidence and allow margins for measurement variation.
coco.triggerDescription: Configure low-speed suspicion thresholds and the idle-traffic conditions required for download verification.
coco.searchDescription: Limit continuous search time and traffic, and back off nodes that provide no gain.
coco.definitionsMissing: Parameter definitions have not loaded. Reload them before saving.
coco.integerRequired: ; this value must be an integer
coco.downloadDuration: The download duration must allow for warmup and valid sampling.
coco.taskDuration: The task timeout must exceed the download duration by at least 5 seconds.
coco.evidenceDuration: Evidence validity must allow for all confirmation intervals and task timeouts.
coco.latestEvidence: The latest-evidence age limit must allow for a task and cannot exceed evidence validity.
coco.searchDuration: Continuous search time must allow for confirmation tasks for the current node and candidate.
coco.hourBudget: The 24-hour budget must be at least the hourly budget, which must cover all confirmation rounds.
coco.searchBudget: The continuous search budget must cover all valid samples for the current node and candidate.
coco.reserveBudget: The degradation reserve must be smaller than its total budget and is included in that total.
coco.remainingBudget: After reserves, the hourly and 24-hour budgets must each have at least {confirmation} MiB remaining for a normal comparison.
coco.sharedBudget: Enabled groups share a budget. After subtracting the largest reserve from the smallest total, both hourly and 24-hour budgets must retain at least {required} MiB. They currently retain {hour} and {day} MiB. Adjust group budgets or reserves.
coco.taskBudget: The per-task traffic budget cannot verify the target speed. Increase the budget or lower the target.
coco.busyThreshold: The test stop threshold must exceed the start threshold.
